name: Hungry Jack’s
headquarters: Woolloomooloo, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
employee_basis: Company LinkedIn page reports 26,000+ team members; lower bound, not a precise payroll census. Workday's undated customer story reports 30,000, while the payroll launch post describes 20,000 people in that pay run; these are different scopes.

go_live.description: Initial HCM go-live April 2025, confirmed by the company's FY2025 modern slavery statement and its HR systems lead. Australian payroll subsequently completed an eight-month implementation and its first pay run; the public post does not provide a reliable exact calendar date. Adaptive Planning was selected in 2024 but production deployment was not confirmed.

contacts.name: Charlotte Stone
contacts.title: HR Systems Lead / Workday Functional Owner
contacts.notes: Self-described HR Systems Lead; owns implementation and stabilization work according to her first-person posts.

contacts.name: Claudio Salinas
contacts.title: Chief Information Officer
contacts.notes: Workday APAC customer discussion identifies him as current CIO; his public 2023 post confirms joining Hungry Jack's.

evidence.reason: Employer page reports 26,000+ staff across Australia.
CPO Jenny McKie is identified as the sponsor of the Workday selection and workforce transformation.
Current professional profile and first-person implementation posts identify a relevant HR systems owner; no team mutual or willingness to buy Mando was confirmed.
FY2025 company statement describes upgraded rostering/time systems and planned FY2026 WageSafe real-time payroll compliance monitoring; planned completion and Mando budget remain unconfirmed.
Workforce automation vendor explicitly identifies Hungry Jack's as a partner; employer supplier event also lists LIFELENZ. This supports adjacent-tool adoption, not a purchasing timeline.
Rackspace confirms Azure customer-engagement modernization. This is broader IT spend and less directly related to Workday testing.
Company confirms April 2025 launch and plans broader related-entity rollout by Q4 2026; future rollout must not be treated as already live.
October 8, 2026 vendor release confirms Hungry Jack’s uses Trintech with Workday for roughly 300 million annual transaction matches; direct adjacent finance automation adoption.

why_now: April 2025 HCM launch, subsequent Australian payroll launch and ongoing stabilization create a plausible need for regression testing across payroll, absence, compensation and recruiting. The planned FY2026 WageSafe compliance program and related-entity expansion add integration complexity. This is an evidence-based outreach hypothesis, not confirmed buying intent.
persona: HR systems / Workday functional owner, with CPO sponsor and CIO partner
gaps: Exact initial go-live day and payroll launch calendar date unavailable.
Direct buyer work emails, direct phones, verified deliverability and team/Adi mutual connections not publicly confirmed.
Mando purchasing timeline, committed testing budget and willingness to act unconfirmed.
Adaptive Planning production use and completion of WageSafe rollout not confirmed.
research_notes: Official April 2025 privacy policy publishes support.workday@hungryjacks.com.au as an employee Workday support mailbox; this is not a direct buyer address or verified outreach channel. HQ is sourced from https://www.hungryjacks.com.au/contact-us. Workday Elevate participation is confirmed, but it is not proof of Workday Rising attendance. No score has been calculated or changed.
